messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for streaming_request in eu-west-1. 10m window breaching SLO. threshold=1.5s current_p99=3.8s. paging oncall now.

amber: oncall amber here, got the page. pulling up grafana + logs. will triage root cause.

noah: oncall-sre noah joining. can you paste the main panel links?

amber: grafana: https://grafana.redwood/streaming/panels/streaming_latency_eu

matt: note: deploy-bot shows a streaming-cache rollout finished ~12:04 UTC (revision 4). pushing this as a hypothesis.

julia: support: two customers reported timeouts in EU, ticket ids CS-3412 and CS-3419. they're seeing ~3-6s responses. low volume but noticeable.

ops-pager: quick checklist: 1) is canary healthy? 2) kvcache miss rate? 3) node-level CPU/mem spikes? 4) routing/fallbacks?

amber: canary p99 ~0.9s (healthy). but production kvcache miss rate spiked 6% -> 41% after 12:02.

noah: running quick query: `SELECT minute, count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE region='eu-west-1' AND latency>2000 GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 10;` -> shows bursty spikes starting 12:02, correlated with streaming-cache traffic.

matt: initiating rollback of streaming-cache to previous revision: `kubectl -n prod-eu rollout undo deploy/streaming-cache` (rolling now).

amber: toggled runtime routing fallback to prefer compact-model variant in eu-west-1 (flag: enable_compact_model_fallback=true) to reduce per-request memory.

julia: notif to customers: "We've detected elevated latencies in EU and are applying mitigations (fallbacks + rollback). We'll update within 15m." :pray:

dashbot: ACTION LOG: rollback started @5234568001; routing fallback enabled @5234568050; throttle applied @5234568065.

noah: infra check: worker pods showing OOM kills on kv-proxy; logs show "out of memory while allocating KV cache shard". tagging eng-infra and eng-ml for follow-up.

ops-pager: propose temp concurrency throttle to reduce head-of-line amplification: set `max_concurrency=80` (was 200) on streaming endpoints in eu-west-1.

amber: applied concurrency throttle via feature-flag console. observing metrics... p99 trending down: 3.8 -> 2.1s within 90s. p95 unchanged.

matt: rollback completed @5234568120 (revision 3 restored). monitoring for reappearance.

julia: support update: customers acknowledged mitigation, no retries lost, only latency. will keep on CS queue.

noah: summary / next steps: 1) eng-infra to investigate kv-proxy OOM root cause and memory regressions 2) eng-ml to check any model change that increased kvcache pressure 3) keep concurrency throttle until stable 4) revert throttle after metrics confirm p99 back under SLO 5) postmortem + SLA impact calc.

amber: I'm staying on-watch and will hand to noah in 30m if stable. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P1-burstwatch created. tags=[latency, streaming, eu-west-1, kvcache, rollback]. assignees=[amber,noah,eng-infra].

amber: lowering noisy alerts to INFO; will post a 15m status update. thanks all for quick coordination.
